extensionName.description: Name of the extension, also used as the toolbar button title and popup heading.

extensionDescription.message: Save the page you are reading to the Syndic feed reader, exactly as it appears in the browser.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the add-ons manager.

pairingClientName.description: How the extension identifies itself in Syndic's “Allow access?” prompt.

labelTitle.description: Label for the article title field in the popup.

labelFeed.description: Label for the drop-down list of feeds to save the article into.

buttonStartSyndicEllipsis.description: Popup button that opens a tab for starting Syndic.

buttonConnectEllipsis.description: Button that opens a tab for connecting the browser to Syndic.

buttonReconnectEllipsis.description: Button that opens a tab for connecting the browser to Syndic again.

statusCheckingFeed.description: Shown while Syndic looks for an existing article or feed for the page, which may involve searching the site for a feed.

pageNotSavable.message: This page can’t be saved to Syndic.
pageNotSavable.description: Shown for pages that aren't regular web pages, e.g. about: pages.

notRunning.message: Syndic isn’t running, or “Allow saving pages from the browser” is turned off in Syndic’s settings.

notConnected.message: This browser isn’t connected to Syndic yet.

tokenRejected.message: Syndic no longer recognizes this browser.

feedOptionSubscribe.description: Drop-down option for subscribing to a feed that Syndic discovered for the site.

feedOptionNone.description: Drop-down option for saving the article without a feed. Articles without a feed only appear in Starred.

errorTimeout.message: Syndic took too long to respond.

errorUnauthorized.message: Syndic no longer recognizes this browser. Connect again from the extension’s options.

errorInvalidUrl.message: This page’s address can’t be saved.

errorInvalidFeed.message: The selected feed no longer exists.

errorTooLarge.message: This page is too large to save.

errorExtractionFailed.message: Syndic couldn’t find any readable content on this page.

errorSubscribeFailed.message: Syndic couldn’t subscribe to the feed.

errorUnknown.description: Generic error. The placeholder is a technical error code.

buttonAllow.description: Button for granting the extension permission to connect to Syndic.

statusAlreadyConnected.message: This browser is connected to Syndic. You can close this tab.

statusWaitingForApproval.message: Waiting for you to approve in Syndic…

statusConnected.message: Connected! You can close this tab and click “Save to Syndic” again.

statusDenied.message: Syndic didn’t allow access. Reload this page to try again.

error.example: Syndic took too long to respond.
